verdict.reasoning: The 300 dpi render of printed page 803 (PDF p825) shows Figure E.13 as a flowchart: Entrance -> 'Set identifier-2 equal to current FROM value' -> 'Condition-1' (True -> Exit; False -> 'Execute specified set of statements' -> 'Augment identifier-2 with current BY value'), and a line leaves the left side of the Augment box, runs up the left margin and enters Condition-1 with an arrowhead. page-825.md carries only the box labels as flat paragraphs, ending at 'Augment identifier-2 with current BY value' with nothing marking the return to Condition-1, so the figure reads as a straight-line sequence. The loop edge is the figure's content: it is what makes the figure show a repeated test-before-execution iteration. This is not page furniture, reflow or formatting. The claim quotes both sources accurately. Impact is limited: Annex E is informative, and the normative PERFORM VARYING rules elsewhere state the iteration.
